items.title: 21.4 Examples of Reactions of Halogenoalkanes (halogenoalkanes ke reactions ki misalein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 21.4 with Quick Check 21.3, printed pages 79-81.

blocks.text: I. With Sodium Hydroxide (sodium hydroxide ke saath)

Halogenoalkane aqueous (pani wale) sodium hydroxide se react kar ke, reaction conditions (halaat) ke mutabiq, substitution aur elimination dono products deta hai. Hydroxide ion (OH⁻) achha nucleophile bhi hai aur achha base bhi. Jab yeh nucleophile ban kar attack karta hai to halogen ki jagah le leta hai aur substitution product, alcohol, banta hai. Jab yeh base ka kaam karta hai to β-hydrogen aur halogen dono ko hata deta hai aur elimination product, alkene, banti hai. Reaction zyada temperature par reflux (bhaap ko thanda kar ke wapas flask mein girane) ke saath kiya jata hai taake volatile (urne wale) products zaya na hon. Bromoethane aqueous sodium hydroxide se ethanol bhi deta hai aur ethene bhi.

blocks.alt: Displayed (sab bonds wala) bromoethane + NaOH, arrow ke oopar 'aqueous' (pani wala), se displayed ethanol + NaBr.
blocks.caption: Substitution reaction: bromoethane aur aqueous sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF page 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Displayed bromoethane + NaOH, arrow ke oopar 'alcohol', se displayed ethene + HOH + NaBr.
blocks.caption: Elimination reaction: bromoethane aur alcohol mein sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF page 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: paani (aqueous) mein OH⁻ zyada tar nucleophile ban kar alcohol deta hai; alcohol (ethanol) mein OH⁻ zyada tar base ban kar alkene deta hai.
ii. Reactions of Halogenoalkanes with KCN (KCN ke saath)

Cyanide ion (CN⁻) strong (taqatwar) nucleophile hai lekin weak (kamzor) base, is liye yeh halogenoalkanes se substitution product, yani nitrile, deta hai. Aam taur par halogenoalkane ko potassium cyanide ke ethanolic solution (ethanol mein bana solution) ke saath reflux par garam kiya jata hai. Bromoethane potassium cyanide se react kar ke propanenitrile deta hai; is mein ek carbon zyada ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Displayed bromoethane + K+ -C(triple bond)N, arrow ke oopar 'alcohol', se displayed propanenitrile, H3C-CH2-C(triple bond)N, + KBr.
blocks.caption: Bromoethane aur potassium cyanide (kitab ke PDF page 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: iii. Reactions of Halogenoalkanes with Ammonia (ammonia ke saath)

Ammonia achha nucleophile hai aur halogenoalkanes se aasani se react karti hai. Agar halogenoalkane aur ammonia ki amounts (miqdar) dhyan se control ki jayein to alag alag types ke amines banaye ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Ammonia, N par lone pair, aur N se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf curly arrow; C-Br bond se Br ki taraf curly arrow. Result: ethylamine, H2N-C2H5, + HBr (hydrogen bromide).
blocks.caption: Ammonia aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF page 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Ethanamine khud bhi nucleophile hai, is liye yeh ammonia se compete (muqabla) kar ke alkyl halide se react karti hai aur diethyl amine (N-ethylethanamine) banti hai.

blocks.alt: Ethanamine (N par C2H5, do H aur lone pair) se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mure arrow; result: N-ethylethanamine + HBr.
blocks.caption: Ethanamine aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF page 83 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: N-ethylethanamine bhi nucleophile ka kaam karti hai aur ek aur bromoethane molecule par attack karti hai; is se N,N-diethylethanamine aur hydrogen bromide bante hain.

blocks.alt: N-ethylethanamine (N par do C2H5, aik H aur lone pair) se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mure arrow; result: N,N-diethylethanamine + HBr.
blocks.caption: N-ethylethanamine aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF page 83 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Agar bromoethane large excess (bohat zyada miqdar) mein ho to reaction aage chal kar aakhir mein quaternary ammonium salt (namak) deta hai.

blocks.alt: N,N-diethylethanamine (N par teen C2H5 aur lone pair) se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mure arrow; result: quaternary salt (namak): chaar C2H5 wala N, square bracket mein positive charge ke saath, aur bracket ke bahar Br-.
blocks.caption: N,N-diethylethanamine aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF page 83 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne aakhri product mein Br⁻ ko bhi positive ion ke bracket ke andar chhapa hai aur naam 'N,N,N-triethylethanaminebromide' likha hai. Sahi yeh hai: positive ion [(C₂H₅)₄N]⁺ bracket ke andar aur Br⁻ bracket ke bahar; naam N,N,N-triethylethanaminium bromide (yani tetraethylammonium bromide).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har step mein N ka lone pair (akela electron pair) C₂H₅–Br ke carbon par attack karta hai aur Br nikal jata hai. Har step ke baad N par ek aur C₂H₅ group lag jata hai: NH₃ → C₂H₅NH₂ → (C₂H₅)₂NH → (C₂H₅)₃N → (C₂H₅)₄N⁺Br⁻.
iv. Reactions of Halogenoalkanes with Aqueous Silver Nitrate (pani wale silver nitrate ke saath)

Yeh reaction paani aur ethanol ke mixture mein kiya jata hai; ethanol halogenoalkane ko ghulne (dissolve hone) mein madad deta hai. Paani nucleophile ka kaam kar ke halogenoalkane se react karta hai aur halide ion ki jagah le leta hai.

Nikalne wala halide ion phir silver nitrate se react kar ke precipitate (neeche baithne wala solid) deta hai, jis ka colour (rang) batata hai ke kaun sa halide ion maujood tha. Is tarah yeh reaction halogenoalkane mein halide ion ki pehchan mein madad deta hai.

blocks.alt: Pani aur ethanol wale silver nitrate ki teen test tubes: chloroalkane se AgCl ka safaid (white) precipitate bohat dheere, bromoalkane se AgBr ka cream yellow precipitate tez, aur iodoalkane se AgI ka bright yellow precipitate sab se tez. Har tube ke neeche Ag+ + Cl- -> AgCl, Ag+ + Br- -> AgBr, Ag+ + I- -> AgI.
blocks.caption: Silver nitrate se halogen ki pehchan (is reaction ko samjhane ke liye hamari apni drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Precipitate ka rang halogen batata hai, aur jis speed (tezi) se woh nazar aata hai woh halogenoalkane ki reactivity dikhati hai: iodoalkane sab se jaldi, bromoalkane us ke baad, aur chloroalkane bohat dheere.

blocks.text: Is reaction mein silver halides kitni jaldi bante hain, yeh dekh kar halides ki reactivity ka idea (andaza) hota hai. Precipitate jitni jaldi aaye, halogenoalkane utna zyada reactive hai. Iodoalkane bromoalkane se bohat jaldi precipitate deta hai, jab ke chloroalkane bohat dheere react karta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Halogenoalkanes ko organic compounds ki bohat reactive class (qisam) kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: C – X bond polar hai, is liye carbon electrophilic (δ+) hai aur nucleophiles ka target (nishana) banta hai; halide ion achha leaving group hai; aur C – Cl, C – Br, C – I bonds relatively (doosron ke muqable mein) weak hain. Bases HX hata kar alkenes bhi bana sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Equation complete karein: C₂H₅Br + CH₃COONa →
blocks.explanation: C₂H₅Br + CH₃COONa → CH₃COOC₂H₅ (ethyl ethanoate) + NaBr. Ethanoate ion (CH₃COO⁻) nucleophile ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Ethane ko ethanol aur ethene mein kaise badlenge?
blocks.explanation: Pehle roshni mein ethane + Cl₂ → chloroethane + HCl. Phir chloroethane ko aqueous NaOH ke saath garam karein to ethanol; ethanol (alcohol) mein NaOH ke saath garam karein to ethene.

blocks.prompt: d) Bromopropane ka KCN se reaction likhein. Yeh substitution hai ya elimination? Main product ka naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂CH₂Br + KCN → CH₃CH₂CH₂CN + KBr (ethanol mein, reflux). Yeh nucleophilic substitution hai; main product butanenitrile hai.

items: Aqueous NaOH: alcohol (substitution); alcohol mein NaOH: alkene (elimination).
Ethanol mein KCN: nitrile (ek carbon zyada). NH₃: amines, aakhir mein quaternary ammonium salt.
AgNO₃ (paani + ethanol): AgCl white (safaid), AgBr cream yellow, AgI bright yellow (chamakdar peela); iodoalkane sab se tez, chloroalkane sab se dheere.
